verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so open tracking and read receipts are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents recipient open tracking, read receipts, or open timestamps. The closest item, marking emails read/unread, is an inbox-management control for the user's own mail, and the 'does not track your data' statement concerns user privacy rather than recipient opens, so neither counts.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
